test_title: PYST 44: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f64cbc0ce6ad37426efe3b9434a5cec87db60069eed466d4b385c1983c4f5f8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d18b47e12ffdb1c0f84fad4e76a68fa7d9c3392d43d799127ed2743b0adf7f9.png]
solution:
Explanation:

When we compare both the figures we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a704ac98e4dc75b18ea13f867c8a7e41e6f2031a36e95173cf4df394e98170f0.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice upwards towards right such that 4 and 5 are visible we find that on the left we have 1 and on the right we have 6 which means they both are opposite to each other. So **1** is the number on the face opposite the face showing 6.

**Hence the correct answer is option 1.**
